## Why Streaming Needs a VPN
Streaming platforms often enforce regional licensing, meaning the catalog you see in the U.S. may differ wildly from what’s available in Europe or Asia. A VPN masks your real location, letting you appear as if you’re browsing from another country. Beyond access, ISPs sometimes throttle video traffic during peak hours. A quality VPN encrypts your connection, preventing throttling and protecting your privacy from snoopers, hackers, and even nosy advertisers.
